backend.storage: r2 — env.APP_BUCKET, opt-in via provision_storage (the platform's BUNDLES bucket is separate and never app-writable)
backend.kv: env.APP_KV, opt-in via provision_kv (cache semantics: eventually consistent, no compare-and-set, 60s min TTL)
backend.cron: governor-driven, opt-in via provision_cron — POST /api/cron/<job> authenticated with env.FDN_CRON_SECRET; tenants have no Cron Trigger of their own
backend.realtime: opt-in via provision_realtime — env.FDN_REALTIME_KEY/_URL for server-published WebSocket fan-out; there is no database-change feed
backend.unavailable: no Durable Object binding, no Node runtime, no Chromium

runtime.scheduling: external scheduler → POST /api/run (tenant cron not exposed)

spec.notes: Worker-centric task runner with a minimal status UI. Best for jobs, webhooks, integrations, ETL.
